corrections.rule_extracted: Hungarian CTA/button text must use imperative form. 'Több tanárt látok' (I see more teachers) is indicative and semantically wrong. Use 'Mutass még több tanárt' (Show me more teachers).

corrections.corrected: FALSE POSITIVE — @TPL_MATIERE_DE_MATIERE@ is valid in Lithuanian genitive constructions. The variable provides the genitive subject form. Only the noun 'mokytojas' may need inflection for grammatical agreement; do not flag the variable.
corrections.rule_extracted: Lithuanian: @TPL_MATIERE_DE_MATIERE@ before 'mokytojas' is correct (genitive noun construction). Do not flag. The variable is already in the correct form; only the following noun may vary by case.

corrections.original: @TPL_MATIERE_DE_MATIERE@ used in Japanese translation (French-style genitive, not configured for Japanese)
corrections.rule_extracted: Japanese: @TPL_MATIERE_DE_MATIERE@ is a French genitive construction and is not configured for Japanese. Replace with @TPL_MATIERE_NOM@ (preferred) or @TPL_MATIERE_FIRST_MAJUS_SMART@. Flag as error.
Traditional Chinese (Taiwan): @TPL_MATIERE_DE_MATIERE@ is a French genitive construction not configured for Chinese. Replace with @TPL_MATIERE_FIRST_MAJUS_SMART@. Flag as error.

corrections.original: Hola @TPL_MEMBRE_ESPACE_PRENOM@ (extra space between greeting and variable)
corrections.corrected: Hola@TPL_MEMBRE_ESPACE_PRENOM@ (no space — the variable name already includes a leading space: ESPACE = space)
corrections.rule_extracted: Global: @TPL_MEMBRE_ESPACE_PRENOM@ already contains a leading space (ESPACE = space). Do not add a space before this variable. 'Hola @TPL_MEMBRE_ESPACE_PRENOM@' → 'Hola@TPL_MEMBRE_ESPACE_PRENOM@'. Applies to all markets using this variable.
